I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I couldn't confirm that Elodie Merriwether is the main contact for the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply.

I only checked places Ilse can see herself: #north-team, the public North digests and cheat sheet, and the shared account files. None of them mention Marrow Agrisupply, Halyard or Elodie Merriwether. I didn't use `search_messages` or read channels she isn't in.

I told her I'm treating it as unverified and won't record Elodie as the contact anywhere. If the account owner or a CRM record confirms it, I'll note it then.
